title: Parse: Extract requirements from Access Levels
description:
Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Requirements Extracted from Spec 17.6.3 (Access Control)

### Core Access Control (SHOULD)
- [ ] SHOULD: Support restricting local client access via three levels

### Access Level Definitions
- [ ] Read-only: GET on non-sensitive resources; excludes /diag/raw/*
- [ ] Standard: GET, Observe, direct mesh CoAP reachability, optional /proxy; excludes /diag/raw/*
- [ ] Admin: All operations including PUT /config, DELETE /keys, /diag/raw/*

### Transport-to-Level Binding
- [ ] USB transport = Admin level
- [ ] BLE transport = Standard level (default)

### Raw Diagnostics Requirements (Admin-only, from 17.5.4)
- [ ] MUST: Raw RX disabled by default
- [ ] MUST: Raw RX uses finite arming lifetime
- [ ] MUST: Receiving raw frames does not divert from normal IPv6 stack
- [ ] MUST: Rate-limit raw TX
- [ ] MUST: Reject frames violating PHY/regulatory constraints
- [ ] MUST: Require local administrative authorization for /diag/raw/*
- [ ] MUST: BLE transports require LE Secure Connections for /diag/raw/*
- [ ] MUST: Protect with OSCORE if exposing beyond local trusted link
close_reason: Extracted 14 requirements from spec section 17.6.3 (Access Control) and 17.5.4 (Raw Diagnostics): 1 SHOULD for three-tier access control, 3 access level definitions (Read-only, Standard, Admin), 2 transport bindings (USB=Admin, BLE=Standard), and 8 MUST requirements for raw diagnostics authorization. Checklist added to task description for implementation tracking.
